name: @activepieces/piece-readwise
description: Save and retrieve your highlights from Readwise — your reading notes, all in one place.

auth.description: Your Readwise access token. Get it at https://readwise.io/access_token

get_highlights.name: get_highlights
get_highlights.description: Retrieve your Readwise highlights, optionally filtered by book or date.

book_id.description: The book or article to filter highlights by.

auth.description: Your Readwise access token. Get it at https://readwise.io/access_token

updated_after.description: Return only highlights updated after this date.

page_size.description: Number of highlights to return per page (max 1000).

page.description: Which page of results to return (starts at 1).

aiMetadata.description: Lists highlights from the connected Readwise account. With no filters it returns all highlights (paginated); set book_id to scope to one source or updated_after to fetch only highlights changed since a timestamp. Use when an agent needs to read or search existing highlights. Read-only and idempotent.

create_highlight.name: create_highlight
create_highlight.description: Save a new highlight to Readwise.

text.description: The text you want to save as a highlight.

title.description: Title of the book, article, or source.

source_url.description: URL of the article or webpage.

source_type.description: An identifier for your app/source, e.g. "my_app" (3–64 chars, no spaces).

note.description: Optional note to attach to the highlight.

location.description: Position of the highlight in the source.

location_type.description: How the location above is measured.

highlight_url.description: A unique URL that links directly to this highlight.

highlighted_at.description: Date when the highlight was made (defaults to now).

aiMetadata.description: Saves a new highlight to the connected Readwise account, optionally attaching source metadata (title, author, URL, category) and a note. Use when an agent needs to capture a passage or quote into Readwise. Only the highlight text is required; not idempotent — each call appends a new highlight.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Your Readwise access token. Get it at https://readwise.io/access_token

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Your Readwise access token. Get it at https://readwise.io/access_token

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_highlight.name: new_highlight
new_highlight.description: Fires when a new highlight is saved to Readwise.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new highlight is created in the connected Readwise account, emitting that highlight. Polls Readwise on an interval and surfaces each newly added highlight as a separate event.

sampleData.text: The best investment you can make is in yourself.
